query: We have four local-first tools: dictation, meetings, agent control, and a UI framework. Find the strongest wedge.
expected_behavior: Frames one user, job, and measurable win before listing ideas.
Fans out distinct facets and returns evidence plus a bet per facet.
Forms structurally different theses and judges them blind.
Selects one wedge with an alpha hypothesis and a kill criterion.
baseline_failure: Without the skill, the model merges all four products into one platform and lists features.
